Package org.example.controller

Interface IControllerVtoM

All Known Implementing Classes:
Controller
public interface IControllerVtoM
Controller interface exposed to the user interface (View-to-Model).

Defines the contract through which the JavaFX UI layer triggers simulation execution controls (start, stop, pause, speed adjustment), manages preset parameter configurations, and retrieves historical run logs from database persistence.

Version:
3.0
Author:
Illia, Niklas, Anja
